source.text: FINDINGS: The heart size and pulmonary vascularity appear within normal limits.
FINDINGS: Lungs are free of focal airspace disease.
FINDINGS: No pleural effusion or pneumothorax is seen.
FINDINGS: XXXX XXXX foreign body is noted in the soft tissues of the left chest wall.
IMPRESSION: No evidence of active disease.

candidate.text: FINDINGS: The heart size and pulmonary vascularity appear within normal limits.
FINDINGS: Lungs are free of focal airspace disease.
FINDINGS: No pleural effusion or pneumothorax is seen.
FINDINGS: No foreign body is noted in the soft tissues of the left chest wall.
IMPRESSION: No evidence of active disease.

changes.description: The foreign body in the left chest wall was omitted from the findings.

rationale: The original report correctly identifies a foreign body in the left chest wall. The images clearly show a small, dense foreign body in the soft tissues of the left chest wall. To introduce a clinically meaningful error, I have omitted this finding from the report. This constitutes an 'omission' error, as a visible finding is not reported. The impression remains consistent with the altered findings, creating a subtle error where the impression of 'no evidence of active disease' is now misleading due to the omitted foreign body.
